episode_summary: In this episode, Greg Roeder shares how he transformed his real estate business by focusing on relationship-building through community events and targeted content. He discusses overcoming the 'invisible agent' problem and emphasizes the importance of delegating tasks to maintain a healthy work-life balance. Greg's insights offer actionable strategies for agents looking to grow their business through authentic connections and niche marketing.
